test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(7, 17, 35)

(5, 11, 23)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: First number × 3 - 4 = Second number,

Second number × 2 + 1 = Third number.

Given,

(7, 17, 35)

⇒ 7 × 3 - 4 = 17,

⇒ 17 × 2 + 1 = 35.

(5, 11, 23)

⇒ 5 × 3 - 4 = 11,

⇒11 × 2 + 1 = 23.

Now, checking the options:

Option 1): (11, 29, 58)

⇒ 11 × 3 - 4 = 29,

⇒ 29 × 2 + 1 ≠ 59.

**Option 2): (9, 23, 47)**

⇒ 9 × 3 - 4 = 23,

⇒ 23 × 2 + 1 = 47.

Option 3): (8, 20, 39)

⇒ 8 × 3 - 4 = 20,

⇒ 20 × 2 + 1 ≠ 41.

Option 4): (10, 26, 54)

⇒ 10 × 3 - 4 = 26,

⇒ 26 × 2 + 1 ≠ 53.

Hence, the correct option is "Option (2)".
